notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, Shopify storefront) worked throughout, no block encountered (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; generic paths like /search disallowed for crawlers, not relevant here). Site is Shopify + Bloomreach (dxpapi, account_id=7981, domain_key=arhaus_us) merchandising widget confirmed via window.bloomreachConfig in page source; PLP HTML ships an empty product grid (0 product links found in raw HTML) because the grid is client-rendered by the Bloomreach widget, so qty was verified via /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 pagination counting distinct product ids - the same independent cross-check method this exact site's prior Home-Decor pass validated (agreed with the rendered header within 1 unit across 23/23 categories in that pass). Navigation discovery: checked https://www.arhaus.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml (full list of 524 collection handles, single file) for best/top/popular/trend/favorite keyword handles - only /collections/best-sellers matched. Checked homepage nav/mega-menu and footer for 'Best Sellers'/'Customer Favorites'/'Popular'/'Trending' links - none found in the crawled nav/footer HTML (best-sellers is reachable only via sitemap + direct URL, not a mega-menu link on this pass, but the page itself is fully genuine: title 'Best Sellers - Arhaus', meta description 'Find high-quality furniture and decor sure to suit every room in your home. Shop Arhaus best sellers today', and 142 real distinct products via products.json). Also probed /collections/bestsellers, best-selling, top-sellers, popular, customer-favorites, most-popular, trending - all 404, confirming best-sellers is the sole handle. Found /collections/designer-favorites (56 products, title 'Designer Favorites') via sitemap; opened and excluded it - it is the design team's own curated picks ('Designer Favorites', not customer-driven popularity), which does not match the Bestsellers/Customer-Favorites target-term signal (popularity/sales-based), so it is a distinct editorial-curation concept, not a Bestsellers PLP. No room-specific Bestsellers sub-collections exist (no living-room-best-sellers etc. in the sitemap), so only a single undifferentiated row is emitted.

rows.evidence: products.json pagination: 142 distinct product ids returned from https://www.arhaus.com/collections/best-sellers/products.json?limit=250 (single page, 142 items, no further pages); page title 'Best Sellers - Arhaus'
